scope: Mobile user operations; candidate-source and bounded fixture audit, not device or WAN acceptance
statusMeaning: pass/fixed cover only the stated evidence layer. fixed means tested candidate, not root acceptance. Every omitted scenario is unverified; no row implies end-to-end success.

JVM.level: pure JVM behavior plus source contracts; no Activity/device
JVM.result: attempt3 72 tests pass retained; attempt4 77 tests, 0 failures, 0 skips; offline compile/test

ROUTE.level: production connectRoute with fake unconnected sockets, controlled delays/latches
ROUTE.result: 5 tests pass; original monitor and stale reset fail before repair; n30 baseline p50/p95/p99=242/491/493ms final90/94/94ms

WSS.level: real JVM production WSS listeners with fake WebSocket.Factory, unbound ServerSocket and gated InputStream; no network
WSS.result: attempt4 5 pass; baseline2/3 fail; 7 old callbacks times20 profile replacements, stop/reset, blocked SOCKS, stale send, current failure fail-closed

DEEP.level: VM DOM, fake native API, deferred promises

BROKER.level: production broker with synthetic devices and fake clock

DESKTOP.level: fake native API and frame buffers
DESKTOP.result: 8 pass; includes virtual 600 seconds/1200 frames, not elapsed real stream

P2P.level: fake socket/host plus real codec vectors and source assertions
P2P.result: 10 pass, 1 stale exact-source assertion fails; owner notified

RUNTIME.level: production runtime slices in VM/fake fetch

INPUT.level: native injected JS extraction/VM and source contracts, no actual picker/speech

IME.level: production JS functions with fake DOM/native bridge plus static mounting

MODEL.level: fake source model controls and static geometry

LAYOUT.result: selected suite passed, visual behavior unverified

A11Y.level: synthetic DOM focus behavior and source semantics; no screen reader

THEME.level: source contracts, no measured display contrast

DOCK.result: QueueDock edit/delete/send test skipped; no acceptance

TEAMS.level: source contracts and shared official slot inspection
